dictionary.lore: A stone that glows crimson. Just like the Blue Stone, there are cases of it being used with techniques not seen in Elgaia. It is rare in Grand Gaia and Elgaia and the only reports of it being discovered are from those who fought strong demons in Morgan. It's said to increase vitality, but that is unverified.
